parsed.why: No criminalisation of trans identity; courts and third-gender tradition operate for trans people and community infrastructure exists. Offset by documented public harassment and physical/sexual violence toward visibly trans people and rising official-adjacent hostility.

Legal same-sex conduct and cross-dressing; courts convict attackers of trans tourists and a baton-beating officer; funded trans care. Transphobic violence and hostile rhetoric persist, but recourse demonstrably works and no traveller-facing facility or document ban is documented.

Morality statutes enforced; 2020 raid convictions; no recognition, no advocacy, de facto care ban; police join or ignore violence with impunity. State-tolerated targeting plus no remedy places this near the bottom.

Vague good-morals provisions usable against visible conduct, no recognition or general anti-discrimination law, pervasive intolerance, only police/commission complaints. Thin record, no documented violence, but silence in a thin-data state is not safety.

Unenforced 10-year sodomy statute plus a gender-impersonation offence, no recognition or protections, one activist murdered, rising fundamentalism. Partly offset by a documented third-gender cultural tradition and no recorded enforcement.
